note: Floating screen: it is drawn through a portal into the page body and placed against the window, so the reference is the whole default 1280x800 window on the app's backdrop and every box is in window coordinates. A git project's "+" and its worktree list (stock-ui/worktree), placed by the sidebar's project row: the screen is a small icon button (`aria-label` New workspace) and a popover drawn through a portal against it. In the sidebar the button is the end of the project row and shown only on hover (the sidebar passes `className`); here it is shown, at `at` (window coordinates), as a caller places it. The popover is fixed at the button's left (kept 8 px inside the right edge) and 4 px under it, 420 px wide at most (`100vw - 16px`), opening above the button when there is more room there, and cut to the room it has, scrolling. Props are `WorktreeScreenProps` as components/WorktreeMenu.tsx works them out (the project's worktrees from the store's cache, what the host supports, the nesting choices, Settings' empty-workspace agent); `request` is how Perch's own keys ask the menu to open (an empty request opens the list; `remove` opens a removal's question), and a press on the button opens it on the create form. The harness answers the core: `listAnswer` is what `list` resolves (an `error` is the core's refusal; `listLoading` never answers), `createAnswer`, `removePlain` and `removeForce` what `remove` resolves without and with `force` (`dirty` and `error` make the force question; `preservedBranch` makes the kept-branch review), `deleteBranchAnswer`. The agents on the last select are the host's agent list (@perch/sdk `useAgentChoices`, in sdk.agentChoices). The removal and kept-branch questions are the stock `ConfirmDialog` (the `confirm` screen) drawn over the page; the dropdowns are the stock `select`. Which form is shown, what was typed and which question is asked are the screen's own state, reached with `steps`.
